_comment: Retrieval-only cases for the Stack Overflow question (hostile question 3: 'why is that page in your corpus, and what does your hit-rate lose if you drop it?'). 12 colloquial phrasings, each with the doc PAGES a correct top-3 should include for that caller's version. Written before the ablation was run; the expansion logic in w12_index was NOT tuned on these.
